lines.zh: : 向着应许之地！

lines.en: So, apparently the promised land is the Miyamura family porn shop — a development I should have expected given recent developments in Miku as a person.
lines.zh: 看来，所谓的应许之地就是 Miyamura 家开的色情用品店——考虑到 Miku 最近在「做人」方面的种种发展，这本该是我早就料到的。

lines.en: And while the majority of those developments probably entered her attached to my fingertips, it is my responsibility as an adult to make sure that she experiences this brave new world as responsibly as possible.
lines.zh: 虽然她那些发展里的大多数，大概是黏在我指尖上进入她的，但作为一个成年人，我有责任确保她以尽可能负责任的方式去体验这个美丽新世界。

lines.en: : They keep the hardcore stuff in the back. That’s the place you want to be.

lines.en: : Whaddya mean by “hardcore stuff?” This about that butt thing I was mentionin’ earlier? Cause I ain’t gotta see that. Just thought it was neat.

lines.en: : I think that, when it comes to porn, it’s best to just experience things yourself so that you don’t go in jaded by expectations placed on you by others.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，说到色情作品，最好还是自己去体验，这样才不会带着别人给你设定的期待、一进门就觉得索然无味。

lines.en: : Take me, for example. I habitually masturbate to images of cartoon ponies. And I probably never would have done that if someone told me it was wrong beforehand.
lines.zh: : 就拿我来说吧。我习惯对着卡通小马的图片打手枪。要是有人提前告诉我那是不对的，我大概永远都不会去做了。

lines.en: : Sorry, did I hear that right? Cartoon ponies?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我没听错吧？卡通小马？
: 对。你听得没错。

lines.en: : I’ve been on a bit of an Applejack kick lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近有点迷上 Applejack 了。

lines.zh: : 是那种麦片吗？你现在跟 Uta 一起吃早餐了？

lines.en: : No. Like the horse, Applejack — the most dependable pony this side of Ponyville. A proud farm pony who ain’t afraid to get her hooves dirty.
lines.zh: : 不是。是那匹叫 Applejack 的马——Ponyville 这一带最可靠的小马。一匹骄傲的农场马，从不介意把自己的蹄子弄脏。

lines.en: : Now, I learned from Maki that it ain’t right to bash what other people are into, but I ain’t so sure about this one, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Maki 教过我，不该去贬低别人喜欢的东西，不过这次我可就不好说了，Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ll show you the light eventually. You’ll understand one day.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我总有一天会让你见识到那道光明的。你会懂的。

lines.en: : Oh, I get it. It’s like choosin’ a favorite sports team. It’s better to pick for yourself instead of just doin’ what ‘yer folks want ya to do, right?
lines.zh: : 哦，我懂了。就像挑一支自己喜欢的球队。自己选比照着爸妈的意思来要好，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know. You should be very aware by now that I’m not a sports person. But I {i}am{/i} a porn person, which means you should take everything I say very seriously while we’re here.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道。你现在应该很清楚我不是个体育迷。但我{i}是{/i}个色情迷，所以只要我们还在这儿，我说的话你都得当真。

lines.en: : Roger that, Sensei. My fate is in your hands.
lines.zh: : 收到，Sensei。我的命运就交到你手上了。

lines.en: : Right now, our main goal is to think of an objective. Why are we here? What is it we seek within these walls today? Knowledge? Pleasure? Or perhaps...Student Council Punishment Games Volume 9?
lines.zh: : 现在，我们的首要任务是想出一个目标。我们为什么来这儿？今天我们要在这些墙里寻找什么？知识？快感？还是说……《学生会惩罚游戏》第九卷？

lines.en: : Wait, volume 9? Do I gotta watch the other ones first?
lines.zh: : 等等，第九卷？那我得先把前面几卷看一遍吗？

lines.en: : No, but you probably should. The storyline is actually extremely gripping and dramatic. And the main character looks and acts a lot like Makoto.
lines.zh: : 不用，不过你大概应该看。那剧情其实相当扣人心弦、充满戏剧性。而且主角的言行举止跟 Makoto 特别像。

lines.en: : So she’s like, one of them straight-laced, smartypants types with a secret freaky side?
lines.zh: : 所以她是那种一本正经、爱显聪明的类型，私下里却有很变态的一面？

lines.en: : That’s right. And she won’t stop until she’s been punished by everyone in town.
lines.zh: : 没错。而且在全镇所有人都惩罚过她之前，她是不会停下来的。
: 不会停下来干嘛？

lines.en: : You know...just...she won’t. Don’t ask questions.
lines.zh: : 你知道的……就是……她不会停的。别问了。

lines.zh: : 连问题都不让问，我还怎么学性与色情那些东西啊？你不是该当我的向导、带我走上通往「棒棒镇」的路吗？

lines.zh: : 我已经不被允许进棒棒镇了。其他人都在嫉妒。

lines.en: : That’s fine. You just gotta get me to the gate. I can figure out the rest.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你只要把我送到大门口就行。剩下的我自己能搞定。

lines.zh: : 我不会把你丢在棒棒镇的，Miku。你还没准备好。

lines.zh: : 我对所有的色情作品都一视同仁！毕竟这是我的本行嘛！

lines.en: : Just not physically. That’s a different profession. And it costs extra. And I’m going to make you sign a waiver.

lines.en: : That’s just because you’re not ready yet! But one day, when the time is right, and your curiosity has advanced far past normal human penises, you’ll know where to come for something different.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你还没准备好！不过总有一天，等时机成熟，等你的好奇心远远超越了普通人类的鸡巴，你就会知道该上哪儿找点不一样的东西。

lines.en: : I have demons and ogres and stuff in stock too. Any dick you could ever imagine, I’ve pulled out of a box. That’s right, Miku. Whether it be Bad Dragon or the Official Dildo Saber, I’ve got anything you-

lines.zh: : Maki，我知道你骨子里是个推销员，不过你最好记一下自己是在{i}向{/i}谁推销。

: 你们俩跟你们的……{i}马……{/i}慢慢玩吧……

lines.zh: : 只是时间。就这样。我最近几乎没跟任何人说过话，所以别把我没来串门这件事放在心上。

lines.zh: : 嗯，细节我就不细说了，我觉得她的{i}时机{/i}终于到了。既然没有别人来带她入门，那我和她大概真的得找个时间好好谈谈。

lines.zh: : 我不想谈这个。

lines.zh: : 可应许之地怎么办？你不是想让 Maki 帮你开始探索那个世界吗——

lines.en: : Well...now what, then? Are we just going home?

lines.en: : M-Miku?! You can’t say things like that in front of a teacher! You’re going to get in trouble!
lines.zh: : M……Miku？！你不能在老师面前说这种话！你会惹上麻烦的！

lines.en: : There are a lotta things I shouldn’t be doin’, Karin. But ya girl’s headin’ down a long and lonely road full of sausage and sweat and she ain’t got no more time for censorship.
lines.zh: : 我不该干的事多了去了，Karin。可你姐姐我正要走上一条又长又孤独、满是香肠和汗水的路，我已经没空再自我审查了。

lines.en: : Nonsense. There is always time for censorship as we are far too young to be exposed to material that could begin to shape the world in a negative-
lines.zh: : 胡说。自我审查永远都不嫌晚，因为我们还太年轻，不该接触那些可能以负面方式塑造世界的素材——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Sensei, what are your thoughts on censorship?
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦吧啦。Sensei，你对审查制度有什么看法？

lines.en: : {i}I am your accountant after all. And some would say that's like having no hair whatsoever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}毕竟我是你的会计嘛。而且有人说，那跟一根头发都没有差不多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't actually like the third season of Seinfeld.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}其实我不太喜欢《宋飞正传》的第三季。{/i}
: {i}（飞机音效）{/i}
: 弃权。

lines.en: : Sensei just knows that censorship makes everything better and that the world would be a happier, sunnier place if we would all just watch daytime television.
lines.zh: : Sensei 只是心里清楚，审查能让一切都变得更好，而且只要我们大家都去看日间电视节目，这世界就会变成一个更快乐、更阳光的地方。

lines.en: : Okay, forget the censorship thing since it’s clear all three of us ain’t gonna get on the same wavelength for it. But that don’t mean we can’t still find a way to have fun.
lines.zh: : 好吧，审查的事就不说了，显然我们三个在这上面是聊不到一块儿去的。不过这不代表我们就找不到法子玩得开心。

lines.en: : Miku, it’s almost 9:00. How am I supposed to have fun after 9:00? That’s pajama-time. If I don’t get the recommended eight hours of sleep, how am I supposed to function tomorrow?
lines.zh: : Miku，快九点了。九点之后我还能怎么玩？那是睡衣时间。要是睡不满推荐的八小时，我明天还怎么正常运转？
: 我哪知道。晚点再睡呗？
: 你{i}怎么敢{/i}……

lines.en: : I taught you better than this.
lines.zh: : 我可不是这么教你的。

lines.en: : Sensei, you on board for some pajama-time fun-time?
lines.zh: : Sensei，睡衣时间的欢乐时光，你参不参加？

lines.en: : Probably not the kind Karin would be interested in.
lines.zh: : 大概不是 Karin 会感兴趣的那种。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I’ve{/i} got the perfect idea. And it’s one I’m sure nobody sees comin’.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}有个绝妙的主意。而且我敢肯定谁都猜不到。

lines.en: : I’m not taking Karin to the promised land.
lines.zh: : 我不会带 Karin 去应许之地的。

lines.en: : And I’m still not convinced it’s okay to walk away from pajama-time.
lines.zh: : 而且我还是不确定，就这么放弃睡衣时间真的没问题。

lines.en: : The three of us...are doin’ karaoke!
lines.zh: : 我们三个……要去唱卡拉 OK！

lines.en: : Oh, I love karaoke! But I thought the noises would-
lines.zh: : 哦，我最喜欢卡拉 OK 了！不过我还以为那些声音会——

lines.en: : Don’t worry! I’ve been practicin’ with stuff like that and I think I’ll be okay! Maybe! I don’t know! It’s kind of a test!
lines.zh: : 别担心！我一直在练这种东西，我觉得应该没问题！也许吧！我也不知道！算是一种考验吧！
: 各位——

lines.en: : If it’s just for a little while, I don’t mind. I didn’t bring any money with me, though.
lines.zh: : 如果只是待一小会儿的话，我不介意。不过我没带钱。

lines.en: : That’s fine! Sensei’s an adult! He can pay!
lines.zh: : 没关系！Sensei 是成年人！他可以付钱！
: 我其实不太想——
{i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}
